title: Senda
summary: Senda is a digital payment solution designed for people over 70 who need to make online transactions securely and easily. It allows users to pay without exposing their main bank account or relying on complex apps, promoting independence and reducing digital exclusion.

title: Bloq
claim: Reimagining home audio as a tool for connection.
summary: Exploración de patrones de diseño de interfaz que reducen el consumo energético sin comprometer la experiencia de uso.

title: Hallo
summary: Simplifying energy management for young households.

title: Parc Central
claim: Visual Identity for Valencias’s urban green space.
summary: Valencia’s Parc Central is a vibrant and inclusive urban green space where nature, culture, and sport coexist. Its visual identity uses the exquisite corpse technique, merging independent elements into a dynamic system that reflects the park’s diverse activities and interactions.

title: Xana
claim: A toast to the first words of love.
summary: Xana is an Asturian white wine that combines tradition and finesse. Produced by a small family winery, it transmits the winemaking heritage from generation to generation, preserving its essence while incorporating a subtle renewal. Inspired by the xana nymphs of Asturian folklore, it seeks to awaken romanticism and celebrate the poetry of first feelings.
